package release

// This file is intentionally stored as .txt. It is overlaid into a retained
// starter's internal/release package to regenerate the independent legacy
// oracle without copying implementation code into the centralized renderer.

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type parityOracleFixture struct {
	Generation string `json:"generation"`
	Plan       struct {
		Version         string `json:"version"`
		SourceDateEpoch int64  `json:"source_date_epoch"`
	} `json:"plan"`
	Tree []struct {
		Mode    string `json:"mode"`
		Name    string `json:"name"`
		Content string `json:"content"`
	} `json:"tree"`
}

type parityOracle struct {
	Generation         string            `json:"generation"`
	BuilderRepository  string            `json:"builder_repository"`
	BuilderCommit      string            `json:"builder_commit"`
	BuilderReleaseTree string            `json:"builder_release_tree"`
	BuilderPackage     string            `json:"builder_package"`
	GoVersion          string            `json:"go_version"`
	Platform           string            `json:"platform"`
	HarnessSHA256      string            `json:"harness_sha256"`
	FixtureCommit      string            `json:"fixture_commit"`
	Version            string            `json:"version"`
	SourceDateEpoch    int64             `json:"source_date_epoch"`
	LegacyOutputSHA256 map[string]string `json:"legacy_output_sha256"`
}

func TestGenerateLegacyParityOracle(t *testing.T) {
	fixtureName := os.Getenv("SPICE_PARITY_FIXTURE")
	oracleName := os.Getenv("SPICE_PARITY_ORACLE")
	harnessName := os.Getenv("SPICE_PARITY_HARNESS")
	if fixtureName == "" || oracleName == "" || harnessName == "" {
		t.Fatal("SPICE_PARITY_FIXTURE, SPICE_PARITY_ORACLE, and SPICE_PARITY_HARNESS are required")
	}
	content, err := os.ReadFile(fixtureName)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var fixture parityOracleFixture
	if err := json.Unmarshal(content, &fixture); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	harness, err := os.ReadFile(harnessName)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	harnessSum := sha256.Sum256(harness)
	root := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "fixture")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(root, 0o750); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, entry := range fixture.Tree {
		if entry.Mode != "100644" && entry.Mode != "100755" {
			t.Fatalf("unsupported fixture mode %q", entry.Mode)
		}
		name := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(entry.Name))
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(name), 0o750); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(name, []byte(entry.Content), 0o600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	oracleGit(t, root, nil, "init", "--quiet", "--object-format=sha1")
	oracleGit(t, root, nil, "-c", "core.autocrlf=false", "add", "--all")
	for _, entry := range fixture.Tree {
		if entry.Mode == "100755" {
			oracleGit(t, root, nil, "update-index", "--chmod=+x", "--", entry.Name)
		}
	}
	commitEnvironment := []string{
		"GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Spice Parity Fixture",
		"GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=parity@spice.invalid",
		"GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=" + time.Unix(fixture.Plan.SourceDateEpoch, 0).UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
		"GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Spice Parity Fixture",
		"GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=parity@spice.invalid",
		"GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=" + time.Unix(fixture.Plan.SourceDateEpoch, 0).UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
	}
	oracleGit(t, root, commitEnvironment, "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "commit", "--quiet", "-m", "legacy parity fixture")
	fixtureCommit := strings.TrimSpace(oracleGit(t, root, nil, "rev-parse", "HEAD"))

	output := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "legacy-output")
	config := Config{
		Root:          root,
		OutputDir:     output,
		Version:       fixture.Plan.Version,
		Epoch:         time.Unix(fixture.Plan.SourceDateEpoch, 0).UTC(),
		AllowUnsigned: true,
	}
	commitField := reflect.ValueOf(&config).Elem().FieldByName("Commit")
	if commitField.IsValid() && commitField.CanSet() {
		commitField.SetString(fixtureCommit)
	}
	result, err := Build(t.Context(), config)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	hashes := make(map[string]string, len(result.Files))
	for _, name := range result.Files {
		artifact, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(result.OutputDir, name))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		sum := sha256.Sum256(artifact)
		hashes[name] = hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	}

	builderRoot := strings.TrimSpace(oracleGit(t, ".", nil, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"))
	if status := strings.TrimSpace(oracleGit(t, builderRoot, nil, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all", "--", "internal/release")); status != "" {
		t.Fatalf("retained builder package is dirty: %s", status)
	}
	oracle := parityOracle{
		Generation:         fixture.Generation,
		BuilderRepository:  strings.TrimSpace(oracleGit(t, builderRoot, nil, "remote", "get-url", "origin")),
		BuilderCommit:      strings.TrimSpace(oracleGit(t, builderRoot, nil, "rev-parse", "HEAD")),
		BuilderReleaseTree: strings.TrimSpace(oracleGit(t, builderRoot, nil, "rev-parse", "HEAD:internal/release")),
		BuilderPackage:     strings.TrimSpace(oracleGit(t, builderRoot, nil, "-c", "core.quotepath=false", "ls-tree", "--name-only", "HEAD", "internal/release")),
		GoVersion:          runtime.Version(),
		Platform:           runtime.GOOS + "/" + runtime.GOARCH,
		HarnessSHA256:      hex.EncodeToString(harnessSum[:]),
		FixtureCommit:      fixtureCommit,
		Version:            fixture.Plan.Version,
		SourceDateEpoch:    fixture.Plan.SourceDateEpoch,
		LegacyOutputSHA256: hashes,
	}
	if oracle.BuilderPackage != "internal/release" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected retained builder package %q", oracle.BuilderPackage)
	}
	encoded, err := json.MarshalIndent(oracle, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	encoded = append(encoded, '\n')
	if err := os.WriteFile(oracleName, encoded, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func oracleGit(t *testing.T, directory string, extraEnvironment []string, arguments ...string) string {
	t.Helper()
	command := exec.Command("git", arguments...)
	command.Dir = directory
	command.Env = append(os.Environ(), extraEnvironment...)
	output, err := command.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("git %s: %v\n%s", strings.Join(arguments, " "), err, output)
	}
	return string(output)
}
